description: Pillar 3a in a specific Swiss commune, from the official ESTV tax calculator: how much income tax a 3a payment saves (federal, cantonal and communal, without church tax) and how much tax a later capital withdrawal costs in the same commune. Defaults: the maximum 3a payment for the profile, no withdrawal unless capital is given.

amount.description: 3a payment CHF (default: the maximum for the profile)

capital.description: capital of a later withdrawal CHF (optional)

pension_fund.description: member of a pension fund (default true)

name: pillar3a_tax
